modes.name_zh: 以诗存名与口传共同体交付法（把作品当作共同体的记忆制度）
modes.name_en: Kleos Aphthiton: Delivering the Work to a Community as Its Memory Institution
modes.domain_zh: 文化传承/公共交付与记忆制度
modes.domain_en: Cultural Transmission / Public Delivery and Memory Institutions
modes.definition_zh: 荷马史诗从第一行就把自己的功能说出来：诗人请求缪斯赐歌，歌唱「给阿开亚人带来无数苦难的忿怒」，而诗中的英雄们拼命争取的正是「不朽的荣光」（kleos aphthiton）——名字不随尸体腐朽。史诗因此不只是叙述，而是一套记忆制度：它在祭仪与节庆上向共同体诵唱，把英雄的名字、家族谱系、城邦的祭仪由来与共同价值以可背诵的形式固定下来，使个人生命在诗中获得超出自身的延续。诗中反复出现对这一制度的自觉：阿喀琉斯在两条命运之间选择「留名而短命」；萨耳佩冬对同伴解释为何人要为荣誉冒死；赫克托耳祈祷儿子胜过自己；歌者得摩多科斯在淮阿喀亚宫廷上唱出英雄的事迹而听众落泪。这条方法的可迁移要点是：先明确作品要替共同体记住什么（谁、为谁、因何值得被记住），再设计可背诵、可重演、可在公共场合交付的形式；把「被记住」写成作品内部的价值，使参与者知道自己的行动将被如何叙述；并接受公共检验——作品的价值由它在共同体中的反复使用而非私人品味决定。方法论签名：把作品当作共同体的记忆制度来设计——先定要记住的对象与理由，再选可背诵、可重演、可在公共场合交付的形式，并把「被如何记住」写进作品内部的价值系统，让传承本身成为内容的一部分。
modes.definition_en: The epics state their own function in the first line: the poet asks the Muse for the song, the song is of the wrath that brought countless pains on the Achaeans, and what the heroes in it fight for is imperishable glory, kleos aphthiton - a name that does not rot with the body. The epic is therefore not only narration but a memory institution. It is sung to a community at festivals and sacrifices, fixing in recitable form the names of heroes, the genealogies of families, the origins of local cults and the shared values, so that an individual life gains a continuation beyond itself in the poem. The poems are repeatedly conscious of this function. Achilles chooses between two fates and takes the short life with the name; Sarpedon explains to his companion why men risk death for honour; Hector prays that his son may be better than he; Demodocus sings heroic deeds in the Phaeacian hall while his audience weeps. Four points of practice follow. Decide first what the work must remember for the community - who, for whom, and why they deserve to be remembered. Then design a form that can be recited, re-performed and delivered in public. Write being remembered into the work's internal system of value, so participants know how their actions will be told. And accept public testing: the work's worth is set by its repeated use in a community, not by private taste. Two conditions keep it from becoming propaganda. What is remembered must include cost and failure, not only triumph - the Iliad is a poem about a victory army's suffering. And the community must be able to re-perform the work without the author, since a memory institution that depends on one living performer is not an institution. Method signature: design the work as a community's memory institution - fix what and why it must remember, choose a recitable, re-performable, publicly delivered form, write how one will be remembered into the internal value system, and make transmission part of the content.
modes.source_chapter: 《伊利亚特》第 1 卷（缪斯呼告与「无数苦难」的主题）、第 9 卷（两条命运与不朽荣光）、第 12 卷（萨耳佩冬论荣誉与死亡）、第 6 卷（赫克托耳为儿子祈祷）、第 24 卷（葬礼与哀悼的公共形式）；《奥德赛》卷 1、8（歌者与听众：得摩多科斯演唱、奥德修斯落泪）、卷 8 与卷 9（对往事的歌唱即英雄的延续）
modes.key_quote_zh: 「ἀεὶ δέ μοι... κλέος... ἄφθιτον」——《伊利亚特》第 9 卷第 413 行：若我留下围攻特洛伊，我的名声将不朽（κλέος ἄφθιτον），而生命将早早结束（古希腊文原文；中文按通行义撮译。全诗的价值系统在第一卷的「愤怒」之后，由英雄自己对「被记住」的选择说出来）。
modes.key_quote_en: "ἀεὶ δέ μοι... κλέος... ἄφθιτον" - Iliad 9.413: if I stay and besiege Troy, my glory will be imperishable and my life will end early (Greek text; English rendered according to the standard sense. After the wrath of Book 1, the poem's system of value is stated by the hero himself as a choice about being remembered.)
process_zh: 确定要记住什么：明确作品替共同体保存的对象（人名、事迹、祭仪缘由、共同价值）与记住它的理由，避免无选择的纪念
设计可背诵可重演的形式：选择能被重复使用、能被他人独立交付的形态（唱段、仪式、口号、可传抄的文本），而不是依赖作者在场的私人交付
把「被如何记住」写进内容：让人物与参与者知道自己的行动将被怎样叙述，使荣誉机制在作品内部成立并可被审视
接受公共检验并留下代价：在公共场合交付、由共同体反复使用来决定价值，同时把失败与损失一并记住，避免只留胜利
process_en: Decide what must be remembered: fix what the work preserves for the community - names, deeds, the origins of rites, shared values - and why, so that commemoration is selective rather than indiscriminate

Design a recitable, re-performable form: choose a shape that others can reuse and deliver independently (a song section, a rite, a slogan, a text that can be copied and passed on) rather than a private delivery that depends on the author's presence

Write how one will be remembered into the content: let characters and participants know in what terms their actions will be told, so that the mechanism of honour exists inside the work and can be examined
Submit to public testing and keep the cost: deliver in public and let repeated use by the community set the value, while remembering losses and failures along with victories
representative_cases_zh: 萨耳佩冬的荣誉论（《伊利亚特》第 12 卷）：吕基亚的王子对同伴说，我们之所以享有最好的肉、酒与土地，正是因为我们站在最前面冒死作战；如果逃走就能长生，我不会上阵，但死亡的命运早已注定，因此我们只能去争那份「被人记住」的荣光。这段话把作品的价值系统明说：分配（更好的份额）与义务（站在最前）被绑定，记忆是这套交换的最终支付
得摩多科斯的演唱与听众落泪（《奥德赛》卷 8）：歌者在淮阿喀亚宫廷上唱特洛伊的战事，奥德修斯掩面流泪；随后他本人要求歌者唱木马之事，并以此讲述自己的经历。作品在此展示了自身的运作：一个共同体的公共场合以歌唱保存过去的苦难，而当事人在场听见自己被如何记忆——记忆制度与内容互为镜像
反面警示：只记胜利不记代价——把传承做成单纯的庆祝，失败、损失与错误被删去，作品因此无法承担真实（《伊利亚特》并不回避联军遭受的惨败与主将的过失）。另一种失误是形式不可重演：依赖作者本人在场的一次性交付，一旦作者离场作品即消失，无法成为共同体的记忆制度。第三是把记忆变成操纵：只写被选中的人与被要求的荣誉理由，让共同体失去对「为何值得记住」进行审议的余地，传承退化为宣传。
representative_cases_en: Sarpedon's account of honour, Iliad 12: the Lycian prince tells his companion that the reason they hold the best meat, wine and land is that they stand in the front line and risk death; if fleeing brought long life he would not fight, but since death is fixed for us all, the only ground left is the glory of being remembered. The passage states the poem's value system outright: distribution (a better share) is bound to obligation (standing first), and memory is the final payment in that exchange

Demodocus sings and his audience weeps, Odyssey 8: the bard performs the events of Troy in the Phaeacian hall and Odysseus hides his face and cries; later he himself asks for the song of the wooden horse and uses it to introduce his own story. The work shows its own operation here: a community's public occasion preserves past suffering in song, and the man who lived it hears how he is remembered - the memory institution and the content become mirrors of each other

Cautionary: remembering only the victory and not the cost - turning transmission into celebration with losses, failures and errors deleted, so the work cannot carry the truth (the Iliad does not conceal the army's defeats or its commander's faults). The second failure is a form that cannot be re-performed: a one-off delivery that depends on the author's presence, so the work vanishes when he leaves and never becomes an institution. The third is turning memory into manipulation: writing only the chosen names and the required reasons for honour, leaving the community no room to examine why something deserves remembering, at which point transmission degrades into propaganda.
modern_applications_zh: 组织史与纪念体系：明确要为组织保存哪些人与事、为何值得记住，并设计可被后人独立重述与引用的形式，而不是只靠当事人讲述
公共教育与课程建设：把要传承的内容做成可背诵、可重演、可交付他人的形式（案例、仪式、作品），让学习者成为再一次的传承者
品牌与共同体叙事：把「我们希望客户如何讲述这件事」写进体验设计，让用户自己成为故事的传述者，同时保留挫折与代价以免叙事失真
个人写作与遗产整理：把想给后人留下的东西做成不依赖本人存在的可传形态（可读文本、可复用的方法），并写清为何值得被记住
modern_applications_en: Organizational history and commemoration: decide which people and events the organization must keep, and why, and design a form later members can restate and cite independently instead of depending on a living witness
Public education and curriculum: make what is to be transmitted recitable, re-performable and deliverable to someone else (a case, a rite, a work), so learners become the next transmitters

Brand and community narrative: write how you want customers to retell the story into the experience design, so users themselves become the narrators, while keeping setbacks and costs in view so the narrative stays truthful

Personal writing and legacy work: turn what you want to leave behind into a form that does not depend on your presence (readable text, reusable method), and state plainly why it deserves to be remembered
